card.name: Comparison words and decimal points in labels
card.fires_on: Fires on the decimal point after 1 in ULN limits (1.5 x ULN), and on small linking words in comparisons of drugs, such as similar, to and in.

modes.label: Decimal in ULN limits
modes.description: The point after the digit 1 in lab thresholds like 1.5 x ULN.

modes.label: Drug similarity wording
modes.description: Words that link or compare drugs in a class, such as similar, to or in.
modes.example: the two drugs are structurally related and have<< similar>> biologic effects.

card.plain: It marks the decimal point in liver-test limits like 1.5 times normal, and words that compare related drugs.
